title: Went to new mall maybe?
content: So I found this sub through r/paralleluniverse someone mentioned a similar dream I had forgot about until reading their dream. Since then I’ve been actively trying to go back. Stopped using thc due to corporate rigidity recently so my dreams are back. Woke up to my alarm at 430 and remember in awesome detail about this new place, weird part is that I’ve felt I’ve had the exact dream place (Minus carrying a bucket pin from an excavator most of the time). Outdoor type strip mall with parallel store groups, the type you’d see a JCPenney and other normal stores. Spent a bit in a store like the clothing section of a bass pro but it was also a grocery store. Otherwise spent most of the time between the two long strips of stores. One side was the back of the first row of stores but the front of the other. Main memory was walking through and seeing a odd type slot machine that a man was at. Forgot his description at this point. He got up and I sat down and played it for a second and won the jackpot. Unfortunately the same man who was too close for comfort had somehow cleared the jackpot and I won a small amount of 423. When I stood up I noticed he had pee’d all over the chair I was sitting in and had soaked my shirt. I spent the rest of the time searching for the JCPenney I swore was “right here” while carrying said pin. It’s a dream don’t bash me, now that I can dream I’m going to keep trying to get to my circle shops in a hotel side shoot
